contract.closed_data: Exact closed prefix, fixed timeframe duration, contiguous bounded observation window, exact newly_closed suffix.
contract.subjects: Actual closed candle content IDs or supplied canonical causal objects with complete ancestry.
contract.provenance: Immutable UTF8 JSON bytes; SHA256 reference; exact bounded claim/context fields plus explicit annotator_ref; no extra outcome/ranking fields.
contract.availability: max(declared_known_at, first accepted caller replay frame decision_at). observe_frame advances the caller clock without annotations.
contract.conflict: Conflicting available statuses remain UNKNOWN with every supporting claim ID; no annotator or latest-claim winner.
contract.consumer_boundary: No production consumer migration in Stage20. Legacy projection loses scope/window/semantic metadata; full claims and assessment must be retained.

not_proven: Geometry authenticity of upstream supplied canonical objects
configuration_role: Auditable contract declaration; not runtime permission toggles.
